blocks.text: Coastal Cowgirl is a fairly recent aesthetic originating in between spring and summer of 2023 and is a juxtaposition between Western and Nautical. It seems to be an offshoot of the Coastal Grandmother aesthetic, but with more of a whimsical vibe that is more country-inspired from the likes of older 2000s media such as old Taylor Swift music and Hannah Montana. Its origins are mainly in the coastal areas of the United States such as North Carolina.

The aesthetic has also been criticized for appropriating Native American culture and being a repackaged version of Bohemian.
